title: Submagic Alternative Without Per-Video Caps
metaDescription: Compare Supertitle and Submagic: plans counted in minutes of video instead of videos, no watermark on the free plan, and captions edited as text.
h1: A Submagic alternative that counts minutes, not videos
intro: Supertitle counts your plan in minutes of video, not in a number of videos, so five one-minute clips use the same allowance as one five-minute video. It does one job, burned-in captions, and the free plan exports without a watermark.
summary: Plans counted in minutes, no watermark on Free, captions edited as text.
verdict: Pick Supertitle if you mostly need accurate, styled captions on short videos, with limits counted in minutes and a free plan that exports without a watermark. Stay with Submagic if you rely on B-roll or on cutting long videos into clips: Supertitle doesn't do either.

whereTheyWin: B-roll: Submagic can add B-roll footage to a video. Supertitle only adds captions.
Clipping: Submagic can cut a long video into short clips. Supertitle captions the video you upload, and can only trim its start and end.

switchingSteps.title: Upload your video
switchingSteps.text: Drop an MP4, MOV or WEBM file. Supertitle transcribes it word by word, in the language spoken.

switchingSteps.title: Review the text
switchingSteps.text: Fix words, split or merge captions and adjust their timing in a document-style editor.

switchingSteps.title: Pick a style and export
switchingSteps.text: Choose one of five presets, adjust it, and export an MP4 with the captions burned in.

faq.question: How are Supertitle's limits counted?
faq.answer: In minutes of video per month. A two-minute upload uses two minutes of your allowance, however many videos you make.

faq.question: Is Supertitle free?
faq.answer: There's a free plan with {plan.free.monthlyMinutes} minutes of video a month, videos up to {plan.free.maxVideoMinutes} minutes and {plan.free.maxResolution} exports. No plan adds a watermark.

faq.question: Can Supertitle add B-roll or cut clips like Submagic?
faq.answer: No. Supertitle adds captions. It can trim the start and the end of a video, but it doesn't add B-roll, remove silences or cut a long video into clips.

faq.question: Which languages does it support?
faq.answer: Dozens. The spoken language is detected automatically and the captions are written in that language. Supertitle doesn't translate captions.

cta.heading: Caption your next video in minutes
cta.text: Start on the free plan and export your first captioned MP4 without a watermark.
